pb-social-production.title: Social production
pb-social-production.help: Prepare client media and check the source figures.
pb-social-production.empty: Create a social service order to begin.
pb-social-production.csvHelp: Use your order CSV with columns durationMs,hookMs,averageWatchMs, or type figures from your screenshot.
pb-social-production.retention: Optional retention: time in milliseconds, viewers, one row each
pb-social-production.finding.hook-too-lo: The opening is longer than the house three-second check.
pb-social-production.finding.length-abov: The video is more than twice the average watch time.
pb-social-production.interpretation: Any AI interpretation is a model estimate. These checks are house guidance.
pb-social-production.healthHelp: Use actual account figures. Leave unknown followers or opening date blank. Each post row is date,posted or date,failed.
pb-social-production.posts: Post dates and status, one per row
pb-social-production.localHelp: Deliver the promised resource first, then ask one short question. You send each message yourself.
pb-social-production.question: One short question
pb-social-production.actualSends: Follow-ups actually sent, dates one per row
pb-social-production.projected: Projected if the previous message is sent on time
pb-social-production.carousel: Carousel canvas: 1080 × 1350 pixels, a house preset.
pb-social-production.reelHelp: Use the clips, beat map or tempo, consent and contact saved at intake. Local ffmpeg must be installed by you.
pb-social-production.caption: Opening caption
pb-social-production.captionHelp: This caption appears during the first second. Review the exact cut and caption before rendering.
pb-social-production.approveCut: Approve this cut and output file
pb-social-production.uploadPlanned: Video upload is planned. Save approved files, then post them yourself.
pb-social-production.desktop: Open the desktop app to save local media.
pb-social-production.storyboard: Review stills before a video quote
pb-social-production.adManual: Paid generation is planned, pending provider and lawyer review. Prepare stills in your editor, record the provider quote, and generate manually after your approval.
pb-social-production.stills: Choose storyboard stills from this order
pb-social-production.unitMinor: Provider price per unit, in paise
pb-social-production.noPretence: A synthetic presenter cannot claim to be a real customer.
pb-social-production.ledgerHelp: Record only ads you captured yourself. Live and stopped ads stay separate.
pb-social-production.noAds: No ad captures yet. No counts are assumed.
pb-social-production.smallLedger: Percentages need at least twenty owner captures.
pb-social-production.error.REQUEST_FAILE: This could not be prepared. Check the source inputs and try again.
pb-social-production.error.EXPORT_NOT_SA: The posting folder was not saved or opened. Review the current approvals and try again.
pb-social-production.error.PRODUCT_PHOTO: Add and confirm a real product photo at intake.
pb-social-production.error.SOCIAL_APPROV: Review and approve the exact current work first.
pb-social-production.error.APPROVAL_STAL: The inputs changed. Review the current work again.
pb-social-production.error.DERIVED_STALE: A source changed. Prepare and approve again.
pb-social-production.error.MEDIA_TOOL_UN: Install ffmpeg yourself, then use the desktop app. Local media is unavailable in the preview.
pb-social-production.error.TIER_UNAVAILA: Use the desktop app for local video preparation.
pb-social-production.error.CONSENT_REQUI: Record current consent for everyone who appears.
pb-social-production.error.RIGHTS_REQUIR: Record valid ownership of these client clips.
pb-social-production.error.SOCIAL_INPUT_: Check the figures, dates and required source fields.
